name: windrose-knotboard
description: Windrose Knotboard: the pattern library's blocks on the site and in the editor.

scripts.build: npm run manifest && wp-scripts build view=./src/view/index.js blocks=./src/blocks/index.js --output-path=build
scripts.start: npm run manifest && wp-scripts start view=./src/view/index.js blocks=./src/blocks/index.js --output-path=build
